name: The Fool
description: A beginning with no promise of a safe ending. Its true ability remains unknown.

name: The Magician
description: A hand reaches toward the impossible. One small rule may bend, but never without a price.

name: The Moon
description: It reveals what hides in the dark. Not every revelation is the truth.

name: The Tower
description: When the old order falls, something buried beneath it begins to wake.

name: The Hermit
description: A solitary light guides the seeker, though the path remains their own.

name: The High Priestess
description: The archive keeps its secrets behind a silent veil. Ask the wrong question, and it may answer.
